notes.title: 1.1.9 More Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed lever interaction in final stage of game
 Fixed rotated camera angle during credits
 More graphics performance optimizations

notes.title: 1.1.8 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed new healthbar positioning bug in desktop modes
 Fixed new bug that prevented the light from dimming in the dating simulator
 Fixed VR controller models being rotated during loading screens
 Fixed VR alignment for loading screens and traveling through portals
 Fixed VR alignment when riding the catapult and trebuchet
 Fixed VR alignment for the drone race and rocket ski games
 Fixed weird credits rotation in VR
 Fixed vsync setting reverting after adjusting graphics quality
 Added Oculus Touch layout to the controls menu when using that controller

notes.title: 1.1.6 VR Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Make sure dialog boxes are always visible in VR
 Fixed dialog box size in spherical geometry
 Fixed bug that would sometimes cause the settings menu to be too large in VR
 Always disable VR head physics when paused so menus are comfortable
 Fix loading animation in VR
 Chest minigame is now replayable after completion.

notes.title: 1.1.0 Major VR update
notes.notes:
New VR options menu:

 Added VR thumb-stick movement option for head direction
 Added VR thumb-stick looking option for smooth rotation
 Added VR focus snapping options for dialogues and events
 Added VR option to hide controllers
 Added "physical head mode" for warehouse-scale VR movement
 Show correct controller model for Oculus, Index, and Vive
 Squeegee improvements in VR to make it feel more natural
 Snowballs can now be thrown in VR too, not just the trigger
 Added arrow keys as alternative movement option for lefties
 Fixed health bar placement in VR
 Fixed unintentional rotation when moving from high up
 Fixed some missing backgrounds in the snow entry area
 Fixed some small dialogue typos

notes.title: 1.0.12 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Possible fix to dialog boxes occasionally soft-locking the game with no text
 Fixed Vive skybox issue where the center of the screen was not clearing
 Enabled WMR controllers for testing (not tested or officially supported yet)

notes.title: 1.0.7 New Achievement + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
New "Thrill Seeker" achievement for rocket ski game
 Fixed True Ending on Linux for real this time
 Fixed default gamepad Y-axis inversion (you'll need to toggle this again if using a controller)
 Fixed map rotation in VR
 Fixed look sensitivity and axis invert for controllers in VR
 Fixed controller rumble not turning off after dying

notes.title: 1.0.5 Various bug fixes and head bobbing toggle
notes.notes:
Fixed bug that allowed trinkets to be collected again when returning to the level
 Fixed lost boy clipping through the maze when far away
 Added a "Head Bobbing" toggle to the settings menu
 Treasure chest can now be reset instantly if you get it stuck somewhere
 Hopefully fixed soft-locking that can occur sometimes when exiting a portal
 Fixed a few more typos

notes.title: 1.0.3 Achievement and other small bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed the "Collector" achievement not triggering
 Fixed bug where the hat trigger wasn't removed after collecting it
 Fixed a couple typos in the Trinkets menu
 Fixed several dialogue typos

notes.title: 1.0.2 Critical Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed a critical issue that prevented the game from starting in some countries that use commas for decimals, such as 3,1415
